907f2b0f2160ac23b918e64c57f039d68556ab0c.summary: Positive Technologies reports a 2016 attack on an Eastern European bank by the Cobalt criminal group, which Group-IB linked to the earlier Buhtrap campaign. Phishing emails with a malicious attachment led to a network compromise. The attackers used Cobalt Strike, Mimikatz and other legitimate tools, then had malware dispense cash from six ATMs to money drops, stealing about $35,000 in one night. Antivirus detected much of the activity, and the report says proper security monitoring could have prevented the incident.
